overall_narrative_summary: Full text for Study S213 (Record R774BC8E6F153: Zziwa Nimanya C, 2021, 'Improving governance in the water sector through social accountability, communication and transparency', International Journal of Biological and Chemical Sciences 15(7):35-52, DOI 10.4314/ijbcs.v15i7.4S) is not accessible due to a retrieval mismatch. The 35-page PDF provided in the source packet (SHA-256: 80b567e0658fc459d1be7796a6a1374d928a9426bbe6ef632350e509e0a3fec5) is an unrelated publication by Ramakrishna Nallathiga titled 'Reforming water sector governance and institutions for improving efficiency: the case of Mumbai', published in International Journal of Regulation and Governance 6(1):99-133. Per protocol, risk-of-bias ratings and study design cannot be guessed from S213's title or citation, nor should an unrelated Mumbai policy paper from ca. 2006 be appraised in place of S213. Accordingly, paper_read is set to 'not accessible' and chosen_tool, overall_rating and all cross-tool bias domains are set to 'cannot_tell'. (For reconciliation reference only: the misfiled Nallathiga Mumbai paper itself is a single-city descriptive institutional/policy situation analysis based on secondary municipal reports and stakeholder workshops rather than an empirical evaluation of S213's target intervention.)
